Russian Railways has extended its quantum communication network to a total length of 7,858 kilometres during the first technical phase. This expansion marks a significant step in Russia’s development of advanced quantum information infrastructure. The milestone was reported by multiple global outlets and aggregated by Google News for comprehensive coverage.
